title: SF424 (R & R)
description: SF 424 (R&R) (RR_SF424_5_0) is the Application for Federal Assistance used for Research and Related programs. It collects submission type, applicant organization information, contact person details, employer identification, applicant type, application type with revision codes, federal agency and assistance listing info, project title and period, congressional district, PD/PI contact information, estimated funding, state review status, certifications, authorized representative details, and optional attachments.
notes: Contact Person Email: the XSD marks Email in ContactPersonInfo as minOccurs="0" (optional), and the DAT (05-9) also says "No" for required. This differs from PD/PI Email (14-13) and AOR Email (19-13) which are both required. Resolution: follow the XSD. Contact Person Email is optional.

AOR Title requirement: the AORInfoType in the XSD makes Title required (no minOccurs="0"), unlike OrganizationContactPersonDataType where Title is optional (minOccurs="0"). The DAT (19-06) confirms Title is required for the AOR. Resolution: follow the XSD. AOR Title is required; PD/PI Title is optional.

ZIP/Postal Code conditional minLength: the DAT business rules for ZIP fields (05-5g, 05-6n, 14-10g, 19-10g) state "If US, min character = 9, max remains the same." The XSD defines ZipPostalCodeDataType as minLength 1, maxLength 30 with no conditional validation. Resolution: implement the DAT business rule as a conditional validation. When Country = USA, require minLength 9.

Country default value: the DAT business rules for Country fields (05-5f, 05-6m) state "Default to 'USA: UNITED STATES'." The XSD does not define a default value. Resolution: implement the DAT default in the UI.

SmallBusinessOrganizationType: the XSD marks this element as nillable="true" and minOccurs="0". When ApplicantTypeCode is not Small Business, this element should be omitted from the XML output rather than sent as nil.

EmployerID inline type: the XSD defines EmployerID with an inline restriction (minLength 9, maxLength 30) rather than using EmployerIDDataType from GlobalLibrary. We will use the inline constraint values.
The definition preview presents the nine legal revision codes in a dropdown. The DAT specifies five checkboxes. The dropdown is a review candidate; its scalar answer already matches the XSD.

PD/PI and Authorized Organization Representative organization details and addresses are independent answers. The DAT calls for editable first-fill copies from Applicant Organization. Preview entry is manual for these 22 destinations.
Funding line 15c is applicant-entered in the definition preview, following the DAT instruction to enter the total.
The preview currently retains inactive revision answers after switching to another application type. Review retention and omission from submission XML before installing the form.
risks: This form does not yet exist in SGG, so it will be built from scratch
The OrganizationDataTypeV5 wraps UEI, org name, department, division, and address into a nested structure; the JSON schema needs to reflect this nesting under `applicant_info.organization_info`

The AORInfoType is structurally nearly identical to OrganizationContactPersonDataType but defined separately in the XSD to work around XML Schema restriction inheritance limitations; the implementation should share a common component
The RevisionCode checkboxes map to combined enum values (AC, AD, BC, BD, E) with valid combinations enforced; this requires custom validation logic
SmallBusinessOrganizationType is nillable, meaning it can be explicitly set to nil in XML; the JSON representation should use null
Contact Person Email (field 05-9) is optional in this form's XSD (minOccurs="0"), unlike PD/PI and AOR Email which are required; this may surprise applicants
Multiple address sections (Organization, Contact Person, PD/PI, AOR) share the same State/Province/Country conditional logic and should use a shared address component
The form has 3 file attachment fields (SFLLL, Pre-application, Cover Letter) that all use AttachedFileDataType
